_comment: The watch list for scripts/drive-watch.js. Every entry is a Drive folder that a
TEACHER HAS A LINK TO. That is the whole selection rule: this watches what a
customer can open, not what we meant to ship.
WHY THIS EXISTS. On 2026-09-08 the same Unit 1 lesson existed in two separately
shared trees, one carrying the day's four repairs and one still holding
exercises with no code, and the only way to tell them apart was to open them.
A bundle that has been repaired in a zip is not a bundle that has been fixed.
share: 'link' means anyone with the link can view, confirmed with
get_file_permissions rather than assumed. A folder that is NOT shared
does not belong here: watching a private draft generates diffs nobody
needs to act on, and a watcher people ignore is worse than none.
Do not add a folder you have not opened. Every id below was walked end to end
before it was added, and the walk is what produced docs/drive-snapshot/.

bundles.name: AP CSA Teacher Bundle
bundles.note: The live product. Units 1 to 4, Course_Resources, Start_Here and How_To_Use_This_Course. Unit 1 received the 2026-09-07 repairs on 2026-09-08.

bundles.name: AP CSA Unit 1 Course Preview_
bundles.note: A second, older, separately shared copy of Unit 1. Still held the pre-repair files on 2026-09-08: exercises with no code, quizzes with no answer options, notes cut mid-word. Watched because it is publicly linked, NOT because it is expected to match the bundle above. Whether it should is Tanner's call.
